summary: Frontend-only verification of the informational Cost Guardrail on Master Plan, Delegation Plan, and Task Details. All cost strips resolve to numeric Available credits (49,957 → decreases to 49,956 after an AI edit). Cheap-tier edit shows 1–3 cr range, expensive-tier shows 11–63 cr range, verification build shows 0 cr (local). Run AI Edit runs in one click with NO confirmation dialog. Regenerate still opens the plan-diff dialog; Copy/Export Markdown buttons remain intact.
critical_code_review_comments: useCredits hook in CostEstimate.jsx fires one hook per strip; on TaskDetails two strips (edit+build) each fetch /usage and /settings independently. Consider hoisting to a shared context/react-query to avoid duplicated network fetches per render.
availDisplay defaults to '…' while loading — acceptable per spec but if /usage or /settings hang, strip stays stuck. Consider adding a timeout/fallback.
seed_data_creation: None (used auto-seeded 'Contractor Storage Yard Website' project)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Master Plan strip: '1–3 cr', Available '49,957 cr' (numeric, not stuck). Delegation Plan strip: same. TaskDetails cheap task #4 (ccde051d) edit strip: '1–3 cr', build strip: '0 cr (local)'. Expensive task #3 (f6c3e6c6) edit strip: '11–63 cr', projected '~49,894 cr'. run-edit-btn click produces diff with NO dialog and Available decreases by 1 cr after. Regenerate button (generate-master-btn) still opens 'Master Plan — changes since last version' plan-diff dialog. copy-master-btn and export-master-btn remain present. Feature complete.
rca of the issue: N/A — main agent's earlier flakiness was likely due to its screenshot tool aborting in-flight fetches on navigation; Playwright with proper waits (~4s after nav) reliably resolved Available to numeric values.
